༄༅/ /zla gsang las/sreg sbyong gi lag len dang ngag 'don bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// zla gsang las/ sreg sbyong gi lag len dang ngag 'don bzhugs so//

na mo ya mān+ta kā ya/ zla gsang thun mong ma yin pa man ngag gi rgyud kyi le'u zhe gnyis par phung po sreg sbyong zhi sgrub dang zla gsang gzhi bsnyen dang las sbyor rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa rnams legs par thems pa'i sngags pas/ mchan/ lag tu blang ba la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po'i sdom ni/ sa brtag bslang sbyang gzung phur gdab// sa lha lhag gnas thab bca' zhing*// rdzas bsag bsang chu sgrub la bsang*// bdag bskyed mchod pa byin brlab cing*// bkru sbyang byin rlabs rdor dril ni// lhag gnas sbyang gzung me gso sbar// ku sha dgram pa sngon 'gro'i las// dang po sa brtag pa/ gnyis pa bslang ba/ gsum pa sbyang ba/ bzhi pa gzung ba/ lnga pa phur gdab/ drug pa lha lhag gnas rnams dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon gyi lhan thabs ltar grub na bya// ma grub na rang lhar gsal bas sa lha dang zhing skyong la gtor ma 'bul/ lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas thab gang du bca' ba'i sa la reg cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dang*/ oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang*/ las gshin gyi sngags brjod/ slar gtso bo'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du mos pa tsam gyis kyang grub pas de ltar byas nas thab bca'o// bdun pa thab bca' ba ni/ dpal gsang ba me lce 'bar ba'i rgyud las/ shi ba dang po nas bzung ste// zhag lnga ro yi bsnyen pa dang*// drug pa ro yi sta gon nam| |bdun pa dur khrod rab tu gnas// zhes gsungs pas/ long skabs yod na ro la khrus chog dbang bskur sgrib sbyang rnams bya/ zhag drug pa la thab dang sreg rdzas sta gon bya/ zhag bdun pa la sreg sbyong dngos gzhi bya dgos pa yin no// mchan/ stegs bu'i rgyar 'dom gang ngam mda' gang*/ dpangs su 'khyud gang ba'i steng du thig chen brgyad btab par khru gang ba'i thab khung zlum po dang*/ de'i phyir mchu sor bzhi dang*/ de'i phyir kha khyer sor bzhi par rdo rje 'khor lo'i phreng ba can/

zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rje/ thab nang du 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa/ lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa'i rtsibs g.yon par bh+yo/ mdun rgyab g.yas rnams su ya re re/ lte bar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar hūm̐ rnams bri'o| |thams cad kyang kha dog dkar po kho na bya/ de la zhal khebs byas pa'i steng du shing khang rgyar khru gang*/ dpangs su ji tsam ran pa gru bzhi pa kha bad dang ldan pa brtsigs/ nang du rgyab kyi sgor shing shug gdong khru gang pa gnyis gshibs pa'i steng du rdo mchu gcig /mdun sgo g.yas g.yon du shing sdong rgyab las sor bzhi res thung ba gnyis rer rdo mchu rer bya/ bud shing gis ran par bkang*/ ro la sgrib sbyong du bshad pa ltar rten sbyang ba'i bar bsgrubs par byas la/ ro'i spyi bor/ oṃ wā gī shwa ra a ra pa tsa na dhīḥmuṃ/ dpral bar/ oṃ āḥmo ha ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ oṃ/ mgrin par/ oṃ āḥrā ga ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ āḥ snying gar/ oṃ āḥdwe ṣa ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ hūm̐/ lte bar/ oṃ āḥm na ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ swā| gsang bar/ oṃ āḥ.ar+ṣ+ya ta ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ hāḥ mig gnyis su/ oṃ āḥrū pa badz+re hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ rna ba gnyis su/ shapad/ sna bug gnyis su/ gan+dhe/ khar/ ra sa/ lus la/ spar+she/ lag g.yas par/ oṃ āḥdzaḥhūm̐/ g.yon par/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐/ rkang pa g.yas par/ oṃ āḥbaṃ hūm̐/ g.yon par/ oṃ āḥhoḥhūm̐/ rnams rgya shog la dri bzang gis bris pa gnas so sor mar dang sbrang rtsi dri bzang bsres la sbyar/ ro'i dpral ba mgrin pa snying kha gsum la dri bzang gi thig le re byas la sku gsung thugs su byin brlab bo// mchan/ rkang pa tsog pur bsnol zhing*/ bla ma yin na phyag gnyis thugs kar bsnol/ phal pa yin na thab 'gel bya/ ras dkar po dri bzang dang mar snum gyi sbags pas dril la gshin rje'i gshed du bskyed pa'i thab khung gi rgyab kyi shing ring ba gnyis rdo mchu dang bcas par 'phong dang*/

mdun gyi rdo mchu re rer rkang pa re re bzhag la/ ro'i kha shar du bstan la cung zad gug par bya/ ro'i lte ba'i thad du me tshang bca'/ ro la bud shing gis bskor/ de nas pha gu bslang ba sogs pur khang gang zag mchog la myang 'das mchod rten lte ba'i thad du me sbar ba'i bug pa dang snying gi thad du rdzas 'bul ba'i bug pa bzhag /mchan/ dang*| phal pa la gang bde bya/ thag pas bsdams shing zhal ba bya la dkar rtsi byugs/ bla ma chos 'brel yod na spur gyi thugs kar bla ma de rang gi lhag pa'i lha gang yin bskyed la/ mchod bstod/ bzlas pa cung zad byas la/ bzod par gsol nas gshegs su gsol/ 'di ma byas par sbyang na nye ba'i mtshams med du 'gyur ro// de dag gi mdun du slob dpon khri ji ltar 'os pa kha nub du phyogs par bshams pa'i mdun du me yol gangs ri'i gzugs bris pa'ang bzhag go// brgyad pa rdzas bsag pa ni/ rgyud sde gzhan la 'jam gsum la sreg rdzas slob dpon gyi g.yas su bsham par gsungs kyang*/ 'dir zla gsang gi rgyud kyi le'u so gsum par/ zhi ba'i rdzas ni g.yon ngos su// zhes gsungs pas/ slob dpon gyi g.yon ngos su sreg rdzas 'bul ba'i go rim ltar bsham dgos te/ gzhi ma dkar po'i steng du slob dpon ngos nas dbu btsugs te tshar du sgreng bar/ yam shing 'o ma can gyi shing dang cha 'dra ba bal bu/ 'om bu/ shug pa/ kham bu/ lcang skya/ thang shing sogs la bya/ sboms su 'chang gang the'u chung dang mnyam pa'ang rung ngo*// mchan/ srid du mdzub gang pa/ lo ma dang shun par bcas shing rtse mo pad+ma'i rnam pa can mar dkar dang*/ tsan+dan dkar po dang*/ cu gang dang*/ ga pur gyis byugs la/ mar dkar dri bzang gis sbags pa'i mar khu dang*/ 'bras dkar po/ nas dkar/ so ba/ sran ma/ gro/ til rnams ma grug ma rul ba sa rdo phub ma sogs med pa/ dūrba dang ku sha gnyis sngo ljang rtsa rtse ma nyams pa dang 'o ma dang ga pur gyis byugs pa/

bdud rtsi sman gyi ril bu'am des sbags pa'i sman sna/ dkar gsum mngar gsum gyis sbrus pa'i zho zan rnams 'jig rten pa'i phyi dang 'das pa'i nang du tshar gnyis bshams zhing*/ 'das par dbul ba'i rdzas mang bar bya/ slob dpon gyi mdun du me lha'i nyer spyod gtor ma so rtsi gos zung dang*| de'i nang du 'das pa'i nyer spyod gtor ma so rtsi gos zung rnams bsham/ g.yas su stegs dkar po'i steng du mañji sogs kyi khar dung chos so so'i nang du mchod yon rdzas bdun btab pa/ zhabs bsil chu dang 'o ma la me tog dkar po btab pa/ zhal bsil chu dang dri bzang sbyar ba/ bsang gtor chu gtsang la ku sha dang 'bras yos btab pa/ so so'i mdun du mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil gsum la bzed zhal dang*/ bsang gtor la ku sha'i chun po bcug bzed zhal mi dgos/ mchan/ bzed zhal de rnams la rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu nas kyang blug cing las gshin gyi sngags dang hūm̐ bzlas pa bshams/ nyer spyod dang gtor ma rnams chu bzhi'i mjug tu byas kyang rung ngo*// slob dpon gyi nye logs g.yas su rlung g.yab dang ku sha sogs nyer mkho rnams bshams/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril dang de'i bar dgang blugs kha sbyar ba bzhag /mchod rdzas dang sreg rdzas thams cad la sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang ga pur la sogs dri dkar pos khyab par bya/ thab kyi phyogs thams cad tu me tog dkar po'i gcal du bkram/ thams cad legs par bshams zin nas gu gul gyis bdug go// gzhan yang nyer mkho rnams ma tshang ba med par bsag go// phyogs gang bder bdag bskyed kyi mchod gtor rnams kyang bsham mo/ dgu pa bsang chu sgrub pa ni/ sgrub mchod dang sgrib sbyong sogs dang 'brel na bum pa sgrub dgos pas de'i las bum gyis bsang chu byas la/ de dag dang ma 'brel na sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas sbags pa'i chu la las gshin gyi sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas bsgrub bo// bcu pa bsang ba ni/

las gshin gyi sngags dang las chus/ mchod rdzas dang sreg rdzas thams cad la rang gi g.yon ngos nas g.yas skor du bsangs shing bsrung bar bya'o// bcu gcig pa bdag bskyed ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sogs skyabs sems dang*/ ma rig rgyu sogs snying rje rnam gsum gsal btab rjes/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nas bsnyen pa'i mthar thug par ngag 'don dkyus ltar bya'o// bcu gnyis pa/ mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ mchod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs/ byin rlabs dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon ltar byas la nang mchod gtor zhing byin gyis brlab pa'o// bcu gsum pa rdzas bkru ba ni/ lag gnyis khu tshur sbyar ba'i gung mo gnyis bsgrengs shing rtse sprad pa sreg rdzas rnams la gtad de/ oṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod pas rdzas rnams bkrus par bsam/ bcu bzhi pa sbyang ba ni/ phyag rgya de nyid kyis yam shing la reg nas/ oṃ āḥswā hā/ zhu mar la reg nas/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hā/ 'bru rnams la reg nas/ oṃ dz+rīṃ swā hā/ rdzas lhag ma rnams la reg ste/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod pas/ rdzas rnams kyi ma dag pa'i nyes skyon sbyangs nas stong par gyur pa'i ngang las rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa las byung ba'i rdzas rang rang gi mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing*/ rang rang gi bya ba byed nus pa'i phun sum tshogs pa'i las dang mthun pa'i kha dog can du gyur par bsam| bco lnga pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar rdzas sngags rnams lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo// bcu drug pa rdor dril lhag gnas dang*/ bcu bdun pa rdor dril 'dzin dkrol ni dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon ltar bya'o// bco brgyad pa me gso zhing sbar ba ni/ 'o ma can gyi shing las byung ba'i me'am/ mchod sbyin nam/ rtsub shing ngam/ dgon pa'i bram ze'i rgyun bzhag gi me la sogs pa las sngags kyis bsangs/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs la sbar/ 'bar ba shin tu skam pa'i ku sha dang*/ shing skam la sbar ba las sngags dang las chus bsangs shing me tshang du bcug la/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐/ zhes sbar/ rlung g.yab kyis hūm̐ zhes g.yab/ 'bar ba na mar khu blugs gzar bdun las gshin gyi sngags bzlas shing blugs pas rab tu sbar ro// bcu dgu pa ku sha dgram pa ni/ ku sha'i chun po la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ zhes bzlas pas/ oṃ/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge// tshangs pa lha rnams dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa// sa las skyes pa 'dab ma'i snying*// bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni// zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol// swā hā/ zhes brjod cing thog mar mdun nas rtse mo shar bstan la/ de nas rim bzhin ku sha gnyis gnyis gshibs pa rgyab rnams kyi rtse mos mdun ma rnams kyi rtsa ba non par kha bad kyi steng du bkram/ thab kyi steng du rtse mo shar du bstan pa'i ku sha ha cang mi ring ba gcig g.yogs so// gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i sdom ni/ thab dang me lha bskyed pa dang*// ye shes spyan drangs bzhugs bgegs bskrad// mchod de bstim zhing chu bzhi dang*// nyer spyod rol mo mchod cing bstod// dam bsgrags byon zan me pra brtag |ngan na bzlog cing sreg rdzas dbu+ul// rdzogs mthar zhabs bsil bsang gtor bya// lha bskyed mchod rdzas sreg rdzas bsang*// zhi ba'i las bya 'das lha bskyed// phrin las gzhung bsrang bzlas pa bya// mchod pa byin rlabs chu bzhi dang*// nyer spyod rol mo sman raka dang*// gtor ma mchod bstod rdzas sbyang zhing*// dgang blugs sreg rdzas dngos gzhi las// dang po thab bskyed pa ni/ slob dpon lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas thab las gshin gyi sngags dang bsang chus bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ nag po las gshin rje'i gshed nag po/

zhal gcig /phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang can dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ de nyid zhu ba las ye shes kyi thab khung kha dog dkar zhing dbyibs zlum po/ rgyar gru gang*/ zabs su gru phyed pa/ mu ran kha khyer dang bcas pa'i phyi ma la 'khor lo rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor zhing*/ nang gi dbus su 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa dang*/ phyi'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur par bsam/ gnyis pa me lha bskyed pa ni/ me bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las me 'bar ba'i dbus su/ raṃ las byung ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum raṃ yig gis mtshan pa/ de'i dbus su a las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi thugs ka nas dhīḥraṃ 'phros pa'i dhīḥlas ra skyes kham pa'i steng du raṃ las zhi ba'i me lha 'dzin byed sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gcig /spyan gsum pa/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis g.yas kha ṭ+wāṃ dang g.yon zhugs ling*/ g.yas 'og mas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgyas bgrang phreng dang*/ g.yon 'og mas dbyug gu rtse gsum dang ril ba 'dzin pa/ smin ma dang sma ra 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ lto ba 'phyang zhing sha rgyas pa bongs thung ba/ snying gar me'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pa mdo rigs kyi mtshan ma raṃ gyis spras pa/ gos dkar po bgos shing srad bu dkar po'i se ral khar thogs pa/ me lce dkar po'i 'od zer stong gis dkris shing ya mān+ta kas dbu brgyan pa'i pad+ma'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par gyur pa bsam/ gsum pa ye shes pa spyan drang ba ni/ me lha'i thugs ka'i raṃ yig las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu nam mkha' la 'phros pas ri rab kyi me mtshams nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i me lha ye shes sems dpa' drang srong gi 'khor du mas yongs su bskor ba spyan drangs par bsam/

lag pa g.yon dril bu dang bcas pa g.yas pa'i mkhrig ma nas bzung*/ g.yas rdo rje ku sha dang bcas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya las mthe bong srin lag gi rtsar btsugs pas mi 'jigs pa bskyod pa'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ/ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che// lha yi drang srong gnyis skyes mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod// oṃ ag+na ye a dī bya a dī bya/ ā bi sha ā bi sha/ ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya bā ha na ye swā hā/ oṃ āḥdzaḥhūm̐/ zhes spyan drangs/ bzhi pa/ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ rang byung chen po bcom ldan 'das// 'dod pa'i dbang phyug 'dod pa ster// me lha las kun sgrub byed pa// 'dir ni bdag la nye bar bzhugs// ku sha ā sa naṃ ku ru/ zhes brjod pas/ me lha me mtshams kyi kha khyer du ku sha'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur par bsam/ lnga pa bgegs bskrad pa ni/ phyir 'brang gi bgegs thams cad/ oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza sarba bhū ta uts+tsha ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing las chu gtor bas bskrad do// drug pa mchod pa ni/ oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra sat+kā raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ ā tsa mā naṃ/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ zhes sbyar bas mchod yon/ zhabs bsil gyis zhabs bkrus/ zhal bsil zhal/ bsang gtor dbu la phul bar bsam/ oṃ ag+na ye puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ bdun pa bstim pa ni/ lag gnyis rdor dril 'dzin pas 'khyud rgya dang se gol bya zhing*/ oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza sa ma ya dzaḥ de bzhin du mtha'i dzaḥ'i mal du hūm̐ baṃ hoḥsbyar ba brjod pas/ me lha ye shes pa thab nang gi dam tshig pa la dgug pa dang*/ bcing ba dang*/ dbang du bya ba dang*/ mnyes par byas so// zhes brjod/ brgyad pa chu bzhi gong ltar 'bul/ dgu pa nyer spyod rol mo'ang gong ltar 'bul zhing*/ oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/

oṃ ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ oṃ ma hā ba ling+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes sman raka gtor mas kyang mchod/ bcu pa bstod pa ni/ rdor dril dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ */ dug gsum gtan sprug srid gsum 'dul// drag po'i nga ros gdug pa 'joms// tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog |'byung po yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir// thabs kyi sprul pas theg chen bcibs// gsang sngags 'chang zhing rigs sngags sgrub// kha ṭ+wāṃ dug gsum gtan sprug mdzad// shes rab zhugs ling bag chags sreg /thugs rje'i sprul pas khams gsum khyab// bka' nyan sprul pa'i bdag la bstod// ces bstod/ bcu gcig pa dam bsgrag pa ni/ lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mthe bos mthe'u chung mnan lhag ma brkyangs pa rdo rje rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā bhū ta dz+wa la dz+wa la bhasmiṃ ku ru sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ zhes gsum bsgrags| |me lha rang gi dam tshig la gnas par gyur par bsam/ bcu gnyis pa byon zan 'bul ba ni/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya ni/ rdo rje khu tshur gyi mdzub mo brkyangs pa ste/ g.yon dril bus dgang gzar mar gyis bkang ba kha gyen du bstan pa'i steng du g.yas phyag rgya de nyid thur du sbubs pa g.yon pa'i mdzub mo'i thad du bzhag pas/ blugs gzar mar gyis bkang ba kha gyen du phyogs pas dgang gzar gyi steng du brtsegs pa bzung la/ me lha'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas pa cung zad gdangs te ljags rdo rje'i rnam pa can dkar po la raṃ yig dang*/ dgang blugs kyi kha la hūm̐ yig 'od zer dang bcas pas mtshan par gyur par bsam pas/ oṃ ag+na ye a dī bya a dī bya/ ā bi sha ā bi sha/ ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya bā ha na ye swā hā/ zhes pa'i spyan 'dren skabs kyi me lha'i sngags ring dang*/ oṃ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ ag+na ye swā hā/

zhes dgang blugs kyi sngags dang*/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes sreg blugs kyi sngags te sngags gsum bsgril bas me lha'i zhal du phul bar bsam la 'bul/ de 'dra ba lan gsum mam bdun 'bul zhing*/ bskor ba'i tshe dgang blugs sngar bshad pa ltar brtsegs la/ 'bul ba'i tshe kha sbyar la dbul lo// de ltar phul bas me lha dgyes bzhin du bzhes te bsreg bya 'dzin pa'i dam tshig la gnas nas sreg blugs len zhing bya ba sgrub par zhal gyis bzhes par gyur par bsam/ bcu gsum pa me pra brtag pa ni/ ji skad du/ bsregs pa'i rang bzhin myur 'tshig pa// me ni mi dge ba ru 'dod// ces sogs gsungs pas/ me kha dog nag pa/ du ba che ba/ tsha tsha 'phro ba/ sgra mi snyan pa sogs dang*/ sreg rdzas dang ro ha cang 'tshig myur zhing slob dpon mes gdung ba sogs mi dge zhing de las ldog pa bzang bar gsungs so// 'ga' zhig gis sreg rdzas la pra brtag pa skad byed pa ni rdo rje 'chang gis ma gsungs pa'i rang bzo rtog btags so// bcu bzhi pa ngan na bzlog thabs ni/ me la las gshin gyi sngags brjod pas/ bsang gtor dang gtso bo'i sngags la/ bgegs thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes sbyar bas dgang blugs bdun me lha la 'bul/ slar me lha'i sngags dang las gshin gyi sngags kyis bsang gtor byas rjes/ me lha'i sngags kyis dgang blugs gcig /gsum/ bdun gang rung dbul/ me pra bzang na de rnams mi dgos so// bco lnga pa sreg rdzas dbul ba ni/ sreg rdzas rnams lag g.yon dril bu dang bcas pas snying gar bzung la/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mtheb srin gyis rdzas thogs nas lag g.yon pa'i 'og nas nang du bskor la mchog sbyin gi phyag rgyas mar khu ma gtogs 'bul lo// dang po yam shing zung du sbyar la/ oṃ badz+ra yadz+nyā ya/ zhes pa'i mthar bla ma yin na/ che ge mo'i dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang gzi brjid la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/

zhes dang*/ phal pa la/ che ge mo'i sdig sgrib sbyong ba dang gzi brjid ces sbyar ba sogs skabs thob rig pas sbyar ro// mar khu la/ oṃ badz+ra ag+na ye zhes dang*/ gzi brjid kyi gnas su sbyar ba bcug cing*/ dgang blugs kha sbyar bas dbul/ 'bras la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ya dang*/ bsod nams rgyas pa la= nas la/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā be gā ya dang*/ shugs phun sum tshogs pa= so ba la/ oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ya dang*/ nor dang 'bru 'phel ba= sran ma la/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā ba lā ya dang*/ stobs rgyas pa= gro la/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri ye dang*| nad med pa= til la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya dang*/ sdig pa sbyong ba = dūrba la/ oṃ badz+ra ā yuḥṣe dang*/ tshe la= ku sha la/ oṃ badz+ra a pra ti ha ta badz+ra dang*/ bsrung ba mchog= sman la/ oṃ sarba pañca ghā t+ya dang*/ dug lnga 'joms pa= zho zan la/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de dang*/ bde ba mchog la= zhes sbyar ba nyer gcig sogs long dang bstun pa 'bul zhing*/ rdzas re re rdzogs pa'i mthar rol mo'ang bya'o| |bcu drug pa zhal bsil dang bsang gtor 'bul ba ni/ ā tsa mā naṃ gyis zhal bsil dang*/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ gyis bsang gtor sngar ltar 'bul/ bcu bdun pa lha bskyed pa ni/ lag g.yon khu tshur dang bcas pa'i sor mo rnams brkyangs pa me lha'i phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ ag+na ye dzu hu dzu hu swā hā/ zhes dang se gol gsum gtogs/ me lha ye shes pa dam tshig pa las thon te me mtshams kyi ku sha'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur par bsam/ bco brgyad pa mchod rdzas dang*/ sreg rdzas rnams las gshin gyi sngags dang las chus bsang ngo*// bcu dgu pa zhi ba'i las bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin 'jam pa'i rdo rje dkar po shin tu zhi ba'i nyams can pad+ma dkar po dang zla ba la gnas pa/ gos rgyan dang 'od zer dkar po can phyag na 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ 'od zer las spyan ma la sogs lha mo dkar mo zhi ba'i cha lugs can dpag tu med pa phyag na zla ba chu shel gyi rang bzhin gyi bum pa/

byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa rnams kyis bsgrub bya'i steng phyogs nas bum pa'i chus dbang bskur zhing bkrus pas/ de'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad par gyur par bsam/ 'di'i bsgrub bya ni tshe 'das kyi rnam shes so// nyi shu pa 'das pa'i me lha bskyed pa ni/ me lha dam tshig pa'i lto ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las e chad nam mkhar gyur/ yaṃ las rlung rdo rje rgya gram gyi lte bar zhes pa nas/ mthu rtsal dang ldan par gyur gyi bar ngag 'don ltar bskyed cing bzlas pa ci 'grub bya'o// nyer gcig pa mchod pa byin rlabs ni dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon ltar dang*/ nyer gnyis pa chu bzhi ni me lha'i skabs 'dir dbul/ nyer gsum pa nyer spyod dang rol mo ni/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar dang*/ nyer bzhi pa sman raka gtor ma ni/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ wā ra'i mthar/ ma hā rak+ta dang*/ ma hā ba ling+ta btags pa dbul/ nyer lnga pa bstod pa ni/ thabs mchog bde chen la sbas lha gnyis bcug pas bstod/ nyer drug pa rdzas sbyang ba ni/ 'das pa'i lha'i sreg rdzas sngar me lha'i skabs kyi sngags rgyas bkru sbyang byin rlabs bya/ nyer bdun pa dgang blugs 'bul ba ni/ lha thams cad kyi ljags tha mi dad pa'i rdo rje dkar po rtse gsum pa'i rnam pa can la hūm̐ dkar pos mtshan par gyur par dmigs nas/ yi ge bcu bdun pas dgang blugs bdun nam nyer gcig dbul/ nyer brgyad pa sreg rdzas dbul ba ni/ gtso bo la/ oṃ e ka ya ma du ru tsakra hūm̐ phaṭa badz+ra yadz+nyā ya/ zhes pa'i mthar 'dod gsol sngar me lha'i skabs ltar sbyar bas zho zan gyi bar nyer gcig yan chad brgya stong gi bar dbul/ gcig bcu sogs kun rdzob gtan nas mi bya/

yum la/ he ka ya ma du ru tsakra hūm̐ phaṭa badz+ra yadz+nyā ya la sogs/ sras la/ gh+ri ma ya ma du ru tsakra hūm̐ phaṭa badz+ra yadz+nyā ya la sogs/ sprul pa gnyis la/ sarba tsit+ta gzir thuṃ bhig nan trig nan/ rbad ya zlog ya badz+ra yadz+nyā ya zhes sprul pa gnyis sngags gcig po de nyid yin yang rdzas 'bul dus so sor dbul/ de ltar yum sras sprul pa gnyis dang bcas pa so sor gtso bo'i phyed la sogs pa dbul/ las gshin bskyed pa med kyang*/ oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza badz+ra yadz+nyā ya sogs sbyar ba nyer gcig sogs dbul/ rdzas re re rdzogs pa'i mthar rol mo bya'o// gsum pa mjug gi sdom ni/ dgang blugs chu gsum gos so rtsi// mchod bstod gtor 'bul bzod par gsol// 'dod don gsol zhing lhag chad bskang*// ye shes gshegs gsol dam tshig bsdu// thab bsang sreg blugs me lha bcug /nyer spyod chu bzhi gos so rtsi// rdzas lhag rnams 'bul bstod 'bul bya// gtor ma phul la mchod bzod gsol// dngos grub zhu zhing lhag chad bskang*// ye shes gshegs gsol dam tshig bsdu// me gzhil bum chus bsang gtor bya// shis pa brjod rnams mjug gi las// dang po dgang blugs 'bul ba ni// yi ge bcu gcig pas sreg blugs gsum/ bdun/ nyer gcig gang rung gis me sbar nas/ yi ge bcu gcig pas dgang blugs gsum gshegs skyems su 'bul zhing*/ badz+ra bai ro tsa na ye hūm̐/ zhes rigs bdag gi snying po brjod/ gnyis pa chu gsum ni/ ar+ghaṃ gyis mchod yon dang*/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ gyis bsang gtor dang*/ ā tsa mā naṃ gyis zhabs bsil dbul/ gsum pa gos zung ni/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar sogs tshigs bcad dang*/ oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra ye swā hās dbul/ bzhi pa so rtsi ni/ oṃ badz+ra tam+bu lā ya swā hās rdo thal med pa'i so rtsi dbul/ lnga pa mchod pa ni/ chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo sman raka gis yang dag par mchod/ drug pa bstod pa ni/

e/ chos sku skye ba med pa sogs kyis bstod/ gti mug dag pa sogs kyis bstod na legs/ bdun pa gtor ma dbul ba ni/ gtor ma a kā ro lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka ya ma ye sa pa ri wā ra ku ru ku ru ma hā ba ling+ta hūm̐ swā hā/ lan bdun dang*/ gtor ma blugs gzar gyis thab dbus su phul nas/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod kyi bar gyis phrin las bcol/ brgyad pa bzod par gsol ba ni/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra pā da ban+da naṃ ka ro mis phyag bya/ ar+ghaṃ gyis mchod yon phul nas/ thal mo sbyar bas/ gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas// legs spyad 'di la nyes gyur gang*| |gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir// mgon khyod de kun bzod par mdzod// ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang*// gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas// 'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa| |de kun gtso bos bzod par rigs// zhes brjod/ dgu pa 'dod don gsol ba ni/ thal mo sbyar te/ hoḥ phrin las dam pa hom gyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir/ rnam dag rdzas kyi mchod pa phul ba'i mthu byin gyis/ dpal ya mān+ta ka'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang ba dang*/ nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i sems can thams cad byang chub chen po myur du thob pa dang*/ bdag cag gi mi mthun pa'i nad gdon sngon las 'phral rkyen zhi zhing*/ tshe ring zhing dbang thang rgyas pa dang*/ dpal 'byor bsod nams 'phel ba dang*/ stobs dang gzi brjid rgyas pa dang*/ myur du 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ khyad par du bla ma yin na/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sa lam spangs rtogs kyi nyer 'tshe 'gal rkyen bar gcod thams cad nye bar zhi nas thugs kyi dgongs pa zag pa med pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /ces dang*/ phal pa yin na/ tshe 'das che ge mo'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyur gyur pa thams cad rtsad nas byang zhing dag pa dang*/

myur du rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par mdzad du gsol/ de ma thob kyi bar du tshe rabs thams cad du dal 'byor thob cing*/ rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs smin byed dbang gis rgyud sbyangs shing lam rim pa gnyis bsgom pa dang*/ phrin las bzhi bsgrub pa dang*/ dus rtag tu mi 'bral bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen pos grub par gyur cig /grub bo/ grub bo/ grub bo// zhes brjod/ bcu pa lhag chad bskang ba ni/ ya ma rā dza'i yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ bcu gcig pa ye shes pa gshegs pa ni/ oṃ/ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzod// sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra hūm̐ muḥ spyan drangs pa'i ye shes sems dpa'i tshogs rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ bcu gnyis pa dam tshig bsdu ba ni/ rang gis sprul pa'i dam tshig gi 'khor lo rang gi srog rtsol gyi rlung rngub pa dang lhan cig badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas rang nyid la thim par gyur par bsam/ bcu gsum pa bsang ba ni/ las gshin gyi sngags dang las chus thab g.yas skor du bsang*/ bcu bzhi pa sreg blugs ni/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes sreg blugs gcig dbul/ bco lnga pa lha gzhug pa ni/ thab kyi me mtshams kyi me lha ye shes pa thab nang gi me lha dam tshig pa la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes gnyis med du bcug /bcu drug pa nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ bcu bdun pa nyer spyod sngar ltar 'bul/ bco brgyad pa gos zung*/ srab 'jam yang pa lha'i gos// sogs tshigs bcad dang*/ oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra ya swā hās dbul/ bcu dgu pa rdo thal med pa'i so rtsi/ oṃ badz+ra tam+bu lā ya swā hās dbul/ nyi shu pa rdzas lhag ma rang rang gi sngags kyis lan gsum gsum phul nas lhag ma med par bya/ nyer gcig pa bstod pa ni/ rdor dril dang bcas pas/ me de bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag

/shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// bstod par 'os pa sogs kyis bstod/ nyer gnyis pa gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma spyi 'gro ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ ag+na ye a kā ro btags pa bdun dang*/ nyer spyod lngas mchod nas/ mchod sbyin gtor ma nas/ 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod kyi bar brjod/ 'dod don gsol zhing blugs gzar gyis dbul/ nyer gsum pa mchod pa ni/ pā d+yaṃ gis zhabs bsil dang*/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ gyis bsang gtor dbul/ slar nyer spyod lnga dang rol mos mchod nas/ ar+ghaṃ gyis mchod yon dbul/ nyer bzhi pa bzod par gsol ba ni/ cho ga lhag chad 'khrul pa gang*// ma 'byor nyams zhing ma dag pa// bdag rmongs blo yi nyes pa kun// de kun khyod kyis bzod par bzhes// zhes brjod/ nyer lnga pa dngos grub zhu ba ni/ oṃ ag+na ye bā su sid+dhi ku ru hoḥ zhes gsum brjod cing rnam lnga'i 'dod kor bya/ dngos grub ci 'dod pa bstsal bar bsam/ nyer drug pa lhag chad bskang ba ni/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod/ nyer bdun pa ye shes pa gshegs pa ni/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// sgrub byed bsreg bya za ba gshegs// ji bzhin dus su slar 'byon la// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrub// oṃ muḥ me lha ye shes pa rang gnas su gshegs/ nyer brgyad pa dam tshig bsdu ba ni/ se gol lan gsum gtogs pa dang*/ me lha dam tshig pa me 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam/ nyer dgu pa me gzhil ba ni/ long yod na me rang zhir btang*/ long med na dri bzang gi chu dang 'o ma bsres par yig brgya bzlas pas me dal bus gzhil/ me la phur bsub dang brdal dkrug mi bya'o// me zhi nas/ oṃ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ zhes rus bu bsdu/ rus bu rnams thod pa mtshan ldan du blugs nas dkyil 'khor dbus su bzhag la yi dam kyi bsnyen bsgrub bya/ mchan/ zhag drug pa la rus bu 'jim pa dang bsre/

zhag bdun pa la sāts+tsha btab la rab tu gnas par bya/ thal sol rnams chu bor dor bas sgrib pa byang bar bsam/ sum cu pa bsang gtor ni/ bum pa thal sol dor ba'i chu rgyun 'bab nas cung zad nang du khyer la| bsang gtor gyis gnas khang khyab par bya/ so gcig pa shis pa brjod pa ni/ bkra shis kyi tshig bcad rgyas bsdus skabs sbyar dang bcas pas me tog gi char dbab rol mo'i sgra bya'o// de ltar sbyangs pa'i phan yon ni/ zla gsang gi rgyud de nyid kyi le'u zhe gnyis par/ de ltar sbyangs pa'i yon tan ni// bag chags bsregs shing sdig pa sbyangs// lus bzung dbang po rgyas pa dang*// 'khor bar gnas ngan mi gtong zhing*// lha mi dag pa'i gzugs thob nas// tshe ring bsod nams 'phel bar 'gyur// sreg sbyong yon tan mchog ces bshad// ma sbyang ro yi nyes skyon ni// khang rul rnying pa zhig pa'i shul// dug gi dbang po rgyas nas ni// srog chags gzhan gyi dbang po 'gag /de phyir sreg sbyong rab tu gces| |zhes pa khang pa rnying pa'i shul du dug skyes pas gzhan la gnod pa ltar shi ba'i rjes su rnam smin gyi lus de cho ga zab mos ma sbyang na rnam par shes pa la gnod pa sogs dpe don du sbyar nas gsungs pa 'di go bar byos shig /rgyud 'dir gang zag mchog dman gyi dbye ba 'byed par gsal por ma gsungs kyang*/ mchog gi gdung lhar bskyed nas mchod gnas kyi tshul dang*/ phal pa'i ro chog rdzas su byin gyis brlabs nas lha la 'bul ba sogs kyi dbye ba 'dir sbyar rung ngo*// zhes zla gsang man ngag gi rgyud du ro sreg gsal por gsung 'dug pa gshin rje'i gshed la yi dam du bya ba rnams kyis nyams su blang byar mthong zhing*/ sems can thams cad la phan pa'i blos/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas zla gsang gi rgyud nyid gtso bor byas phran bu sreg chog rnam gzhag gzhan nas kyang cung zad bskangs te/
sa stag spre'u zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi'i dus khyad par can la bye ri stag rtse'i kun gsal gsang sngags pho brang du sbyar ba dag go// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
